statement: Every nontrivial countable torsion-free group H embeds homologically into a countable torsion-free group U solving every one-variable unimodular equation; U preserves a classifying-space dimension bound max(dim BH,2). Every transfinite tower of unimodular one-generator one-relator extensions of H maps to this same U with injective restriction on H, hence has a nontrivial countable quotient.
depends_on: Forester–Rourke Theorem 1 and Proposition 1; their one-pair relative asphericity theorem
manuscript_pages_settled: R2 A3(iii): transfinite layered unimodular construction route
notes: The successor map sends the new letter to a solution of the mapped equation in U; limit maps are induced by the group colimit. Actual nested one/two-cell attachments prove dimensional and homological control. No conclusion for arbitrary simultaneous invertible exponent matrices is inferred.
